basics.title: Ibanze
basics.lead: Ibanze bikosorwa mu gihe hakorwa umushinga. Kugira ngo uhindure, hagarika umushinga ukore undi.

policy.title: Amabwiriza yo guhitamo
policy.lead: Intambwe ya 2 kuri 4. Buri gihe ubika hakorwa verisiyo nshya idahinduka ifite SHA-256 yayo. Urubuga nta mipaka y’ibanze rutanga: emeza buri gaciro ugereranyije n’itangazo ry’ubuyobozi.
policy.none: Nta verisiyo y’amabwiriza iraboneka. Gutangaza birayikenera.
policy.suggestionNotice: Agaciro kanditseho “icyifuzo” kakuwe muri moteri y’isuzuma ry’ibisabwa. Ni intangiriro, si amabwiriza y’ubuyobozi: emeza buri cyiciro ugereranyije n’itangazo ry’ubuyobozi.
policy.documentsHint: Hatangwa gusa ubwoko bw’inyandiko urwego rwawe rwemera.
policy.legalBasisReferenceHint: Itangazo cyangwa iteka aya mabwiriza akurikiza (inyuguti 256 ntarengwa).
policy.diffFirst: Nta verisiyo ibitswe kuri uyu mudasobwa: buri gice ni gishya.
policy.diffBasis: Ugereranyije na verisiyo ya nyuma wabitse kuri uyu mudasobwa.
policy.incomplete: Hasigaye ibintu {{count}} byo kuzuza cyangwa kwemeza.
policy.noChanges: Nta mpinduka kuri verisiyo ya nyuma yabitswe.
policy.localMatch: Byemejwe kuri uyu mudasobwa: hash ihuye n’amabwiriza watanze.
policy.localMismatch: Iburira: hash ntihuye n’amabwiriza yabazwe kuri uyu mudasobwa.
policy.localUnavailable: Iyi mushakisha ntishobora kubara hash ngo igenzurwe.

sessions.title: Ibyiciro by’uturere
sessions.lead: Intambwe ya 3 kuri 4. Icyiciro kimwe kuri buri karere: aho ikizamini kizabera, umunsi, isaha n’ubushobozi. Ubushobozi butagira imbibi ni icyemezo kigaragara kandi gikurikiranwa.
